pages.concern: Does a code stack on top of ALLPOWERS's own Black Friday discount? No. In ALLPOWERS's cart on Nov 17 the store took about 5% off by itself (7% from $1,500), and a code replaced that discount instead of adding to it. Under $1,000 our code DEALECTRIC10 (10%) gives the lowest price; from $1,000, ALLPOWERS's own Black Friday code APBF12 (12%) is lower, so those rows name APBF12.

pages.sections_html:
What ALLPOWERS runs for Black Friday 2026

  • Early Black Friday, Nov 9–19 (Pacific dates): Black Friday prices on stations, panels and kits. Product pages show "Bundle More, Save More" order discounts of 5% from $1,000, 7% from $1,500 and 10% from $2,500.
  • Black Week, Nov 20–26: the same order discounts (ALLPOWERS's terms say 10% from $2,500; its phase panel says 15%) plus free gifts by order value: a 21 W SP001 panel from $1,200, a P100 power bank from $1,600, an SE60 60 W panel from $2,200 and a VOLIX P300 power station from $3,200. ALLPOWERS's terms count a gift as free only when it shows in the order at $0.
  • Black Friday Finale, Nov 27–Dec 4: offers not announced when we checked on Nov 17.
  • Codes and discounts don't simply add up. ALLPOWERS's terms say sale prices, order-value savings and codes "cannot necessarily be combined" and that a combination counts only if checkout accepts it. That is why every price on this page is the cart's own total.
  • Shipping and stock: several kits are pre-orders shipping between Nov 20 and Dec 15, and the R4000 and R600 were sold out on Nov 17. The store also advertises a 30-day price match, with no published terms.

faq: Does DEALECTRIC10 stack with ALLPOWERS's Black Friday sale?

It applies to the Black Friday sale price, but it replaces the store's own automatic 5–7% checkout discount instead of adding to it. In the Nov 17 cart test it still came out lower on every order under $1,000.
Which ALLPOWERS code is best for Black Friday?
Under $1,000, DEALECTRIC10 (10%). From $1,000, APBF12 (12%), ALLPOWERS's own Black Friday code, which takes more off than DEALECTRIC10 and the store's automatic discount.
When does ALLPOWERS's Black Friday sale end?
Early Black Friday runs to Nov 19, Black Week (with free gifts from $1,200) Nov 20–26, and the Black Friday Finale Nov 27–Dec 4, all by Pacific date.

pages.concern: Does our code stack on top of BLUETTI's own Black Friday discount? No, it replaces it, and it still came out lower on every product. BLUETTI takes $50 off orders from $2,000, $100 from $3,000 and $150 from $4,000 automatically through Nov 18; in BLUETTI's cart on Nov 17, code DEALECTRIC (5%) replaced that discount instead of adding to it, and 5% is more than the automatic amount at every price we list (an Apex 300 + B300K: $2,549 with no code, $2,469.05 with DEALECTRIC). BLUETTI allows one code per order.

pages.sections_html:
What BLUETTI runs for Black Friday 2026

  • Black Friday Early Access, Nov 5–18 (ends 11:59 pm PST): $50 off orders from $2,000, $100 from $3,000 and $150 from $4,000, applied at checkout; the Apex 200 at its launch price ($1,099 on Nov 17); a free kids' T-shirt or hoodie with each Elite 400 or Apex 300 series station; a lucky-wheel spin for every $1,000 spent; double BLUETTI Bucks for members.
  • Main Black Friday sale, Nov 19–30, and Cyber Monday, Dec 1–5: dates from BLUETTI's own Black Friday buying guide; the offers were not published when we checked on Nov 17. We re-test every price here once the main sale opens.
  • One code per order. BLUETTI's terms allow one coupon code per order; DEALECTRIC is BLUETTI's code for Dealectric readers (5% off, excluding accessories and flash-sale items in BLUETTI's terms; in the Nov 17 test it also applied to cables).
  • Price guarantee: BLUETTI's Black Friday page offers to refund the difference if the official BLUETTI price drops within 30 days of purchase; its FAQ excludes flash sales and special promotions.
  • Stock: the AC180 showed as shipping from Dec 14 and the Elite 200 V2 from Nov 26 when we checked.

faq: Does the BLUETTI code DEALECTRIC work during Black Friday?
Yes. In BLUETTI's own US cart on Nov 17 it took 5% off every product we list, including the Apex 300 kits, and replaced the store's automatic $50–$150 Early Access discount because 5% was larger.
Can I combine BLUETTI's Black Friday spend tiers with a code?
Not in the Nov 17 cart test: with a code applied, the $50/$100/$150 tier discount dropped off. The code still left the lower total on every product we list.
When is BLUETTI's Black Friday sale?
Early Access runs Nov 5–18 (PST), the main Black Friday sale Nov 19–30 and Cyber Monday Dec 1–5, per BLUETTI's own pages.

faq: What is the cheapest solar generator kit this Black Friday?

Of the kits we track that were in stock, the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 60 W panel kit (288 Wh) at $380 with code DEALECTRIC, and among kits of 1,000 Wh and up, the ALLPOWERS R1500 + SF100 at $493.20 with DEALECTRIC10, both in the brands' own carts on Nov 17.
Is a code better than the store's Black Friday discount on solar kits?
On every ALLPOWERS and BLUETTI kit we tested on Nov 17, yes: the code replaced the store's own automatic discount and still left a lower total.
